[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies may be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral skin, and genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation to excise the whole lesion with a narrow margin is 100 % (21/21).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be determined based on the thickness of the tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as the wide excision whenever possible."
]
